name: Lindsay Sanneman
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science and Engineering
department: School of Computing and Augmented Intelligence; HEART Lab
fitReason: Recent Assistant Professor with independently verified 2024–25 new-faculty cohort membership, current graduate advising and substantive human-in-the-loop robot-learning experience. The detailed physical anchor is former MIT collaborative work, not current ASU hardware.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full ICRA 2020 paper trains a 3D CNN to choose grasp wrist orientation from voxelized depth data on an actual Baxter. Self-supervised trials and requested VR demonstrations update the model online. Separate human-interface and workload/trust experiments hold pretrained networks fixed, and should not be described as online learning. Sanneman is a coauthor; the older MIT robot and current ASU lab are distinct, so physical credit is capped at 20.
